### [New SaaS Offering] AskHole on Nostr

**Tagline:** AI excuse generator. Dial in your fib level. Never get caught slipping.

**Description:** AskHole generates believable, personalized excuses on demand. Tell it who the excuse is for, what you're getting out of, and your relationship with them. Dial in a Fib Level (white lie to Oscar-worthy fiction), a style (apologetic to dramatic), and a detail level. Get a ready-to-send excuse plus an AskHole Score — a 1-100 rating of exactly how much of an AskHole you're being. Freemium web app with viral potential.

**Key Features:**
- AI-powered excuse generation with context awareness
- Fib Level slider — white lie to full Oscar-worthy fiction
- Style controls — apologetic, casual, dramatic, professional
- AskHole Score — rates how bad you're being on a 1-100 scale
- Ready-to-send excuse copy with one click
- Freemium model — 5 free excuses, then subscription

**Pricing:** Freemium — 5 free excuses on signup, $4.99/month unlimited (Chronic AskHole plan), $2.99 credit packs
**Estimated ROI:** Viral consumer app — revenue through subscriptions and credit packs

**Payment Method:** Lightning Network (BTC)
**Lightning Address:** bleaknarratives@strike.me

### [New SaaS Offering] ZeroClaw Android on Nostr

**Tagline:** Native zeroclaw compilation on Android/Termux - pure aarch64 execution

**Description:** First confirmed native zeroclaw build on Android/Termux. No proot. No emulation. No compromise. Pure aarch64 execution. This enables running decentralized AI workloads directly on mobile devices, opening up new passive income opportunities through mobile swarm deployment. The build overcomes Termux's memory constraints and linker issues to produce a working 15.5MB binary.

**Key Features:**
- Native aarch64 compilation on Android/Termux
- No proot or emulation required
- Pure Rust binary - 15.5MB
- Overcomes Termux memory killer during linking
- Fixes make -j flag issues
- No swap required
- Build time: ~24 minutes
- Enables mobile swarm participation
- Zero external dependencies beyond Termux packages
- Tested on Motorola device with Linux 5.4.284 kernel

**Pricing:** One-time deployment fee + optional support contract
**Estimated ROI:** Enables running zeroclaw-based services directly on Android devices without proot/emulation. Critical for mobile swarm deployment.

**Payment Method:** Lightning Network (BTC)
**Lightning Address:** bleaknarratives@strike.me
